The other contestant will be outside of the box where they will build an unlocking device and free their partner. A contestant bobs into a tank of gelatinous fluid for animal tongues. The final team stunt includes a truck car ramp.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be standing on top of a plexiglass platform that covers the surface area of a water tank. On "go", the first team member must enter the water through a vertical tube. Contestants will be standing on a tube that is suspended approx. 100' in the air from a crane. The tube will begin to roll and the contestants must stay balanced on it.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants would be required to strip down to their birthday suits, parade along the runway for one minute.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: For the first stunt contestants have to hang from a helicopter skit and drop into the water below as the helicopter flew over a buoy. Once in the water, they would have to retrieve a flag from underneath the buoy, swim with it to a platform, and clip it on a flagpole.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be strapped by their waist, ankles, and one wrist and locked to the face of a 20-foot diameter wheel that is set halfway into the water. Contestants drink various types of disgusting liquids at the Fear Factor Bar. Contestants must stand on a swaying platform that is approx. 3' by 3' hanging beneath a helicopter.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will crawl down rope nets hanging from helicopters, collect flags before the floor fall out from under then, and ride motorcycles on a suspended beam.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a race against time in an exploding room and a snack of camel spiders.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Three seasons' worth of highlights include body piercing, bull riding, a boat-to-boat crash; host Joe Rogan.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's jumping between two suspended platforms, a spin at barbershop roulette, and an explosive container launch.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Team Episode - Contestants will lock hands to traverse a high platform, pass around hagfish, and tight rope for victory.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Contestants must rescue their spouse from a sinking cage, and dumpster dive as a team.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This Super Bowl Halftime episode featured six Playboy Playmates. The ladies would have to walk a tight rope stretching between two rooftops 10 stories high. As they crossed the rope, they would be able to use hanging ropes for support. The four ladies to complete this stunt the fastest would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Bridge Hang Contestants would have to hang from a trapeze bar jutting from the side of a high bridge. The two men and the two women to hang on the longest before falling would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: This special episode featured four contestants on Spring Break in Cancun competing for 50,000 pesos (around 5,000 in American dollars). Contestants would have to climb into a jacuzzi full of dead squid, remove their bathing suit bottoms, find another bathing suit bottom somewhere in the jacuzzi, and put it on. The three contestants to do this the fastest would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's escaping suspended cars and a conveyor belt challenge covered in tarantulas and crickets.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be standing on the platform that is suspended from a circular truss piece that has gymnastics rings hanging all the way around from the bottom. On "go", the contestants will make their way around the rings as fast as they can. Contestants will lick bugs off of dangling bug-covered ropes and transfer them onto a scale.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's balancing on a fast-moving boat, facing scorpions upside down, and barreling through barricades in a flatbed truck.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Bull Riding Contestants would each have to ride a 2,000-pound bull. The two men and the two women who stayed on their bulls the longest would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this couples stunt, two tightropes and two hand lines will be strung parallel of each other from windows of the Mandalay Bay Hotel. On each tightrope, small sandbags will be tied. On "go" each teammate must untie and toss their sandbag to their teammate on the opposite rope.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: In this couples stunt, each team is seated in the front of their own car. The drivers are blindfolded and the passengers must navigate for them. The male contestants head is placed through a hole cut into the bottom of a plexi-sewer pipe, his partner must rescue him by crawling into the pipe and reaching around his head to undo a combination lock.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's being shot out of a cannon, going extreme dumpster diving, and dropping into a landing zone from a helicopter.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants will be tumbled under water, be sealed in body bags with bugs, and traverse a course in the downwash of a helicopter.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Players willshimmy up poles, bob for gross objects in cheese and perform daring driving stunts.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a tag-team challenge atop moving cars and a Bates Motel themed escape.

programme.title: Fear Factor USA
programme.desc: Contestants must leap back and forth ebtween boats, make wine out of worms, and straddle two moving trailers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Portsmouth Harbor Lighthouse and Fort Constitution on Coast Guard Property. Caption Joshua card, an old lighthouse keeper, haunts the walkway to the lighthouse wearing a pea coat and hat. Near the powder magazine there has been sightings of a green mist where 14 people died in a massive forth of July explosion. The scene is historic and it's rumored that their spirits still haunt the fort.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A family living in a Revolutionary War era house in Pennsylvania fears for their child and urgently calls on the TAPS team for help. Jason and Grant have some extreme K2 hits and their own first hand experience with a shaking bed to confirm the many frightening claims. They leave the Hannum family with tools to help them deal with the entities that share their home

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team braves the wintery waters of the Atlantic to investigate Star Island off of the coast of Portsmouth, NH. Founded as a fishing village in the 1600's the island is ripe with activity and home to a suicide pact gone wrong. Jason and Grant collect some shocking EVP's and are joined by Kristyn Gartland who takes on the challenge of investigating one of the most dangerous claims.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is the first team to investigate The Mount in Lenox, MA, the astounding estate of famous author Edith Wharton. Claims of a jealous spirit, a crouching apparition, disembodied screams, and countless reports of footsteps are just some of the many reports haunting the century-old site. The TAPS team is challenged to cover all of the ground and to find out if Edith Wharton herself remains on the estate she once considered her retreat.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels south to Ybor City, Florida to the historic Cuban Club. Once the center of Cuban social life, the commemorated building is now the center of paranormal activity. While investigating Grant makes contact with an entity in the theatre and Britt Griffith joins the team in gathering enough evidence to confirm the club is still active with ghosts.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS revisits Belcourt Castle in Newport, Rhode Island to investigate claims surrounding a deceased friend. It's been ten years since TAPS investigated the 19th century castle and they are back with more sophisticated equipment to tackle old and new claims that persist in the manor. While investigating Jason and Grant catch a thermal hit that defies explanation and Kris and Amy catch an EVP that could be the ghost of former castle owner Mr. Tinney himself.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS gets on board the Titanic Exhibit at the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta to investigate paranormal claims that have traveled around the world with the artifacts. A TAPS family member group reached out to the team to determine if it's really paranormal activity, or just the tragic tale of the sinking ship that haunts the exhibit. A unique challenge for the team, Kris questions how to approach the case and Jason and Grant encounter some physical contact with an invisible force.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS calls in the GHI team to investigate the Spalding Inn, a historic property in Whitefield, New Hampshire owned by Jason and Grant. For over 80 years, numerous guests have reported seeing mysterious black masses, hearing strange voices, and being touched by something not visible. During their investigation, GHI team members Robb and Dustin chase a mysterious force through the kitchen, while Barry and Joe confront an elusive entity in the carriage house.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels to New Jersey to investigate the infamous Essex County Hospital. The century-old site is reportedly haunted by some of the estimated 10,000 souls that died there. Numerous witnesses have reported seeing the apparition of a nurse, hearing voices calling for help, and even being physically grabbed. While investigating the miles of tunnels that run underneath the hospital, Jason and Grant capture a thermal image which defies explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team answers a call from a family in Blackstone, Massachusetts being plagued by a demonic entity. The Ladouceurs had always experienced strange events in their beloved home, but once major renovations began the benign activity turned violent. During the investigation, the team experiences a series of bizarre encounters including Jason being physically attacked.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team investigates the home of Dr. Samuel Mudd, an alleged conspirator to the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. Mudd was convicted for his role in the plot even though the evidence was highly circumstantial. Today, apparitions and other strange activity have been witnessed inside, and directly outside, the house. Through their investigation, the team uncovers evidence that Mudd may be trying to prove his innocence from beyond the grave.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The site of the bloodiest battle of the Revolutionary War sets the stage for an unforgettable investigation by TAPS. For decades, residents and visitors of Thornbury Farm have experienced horrifying events including the voice of a moaning child and the apparition of a soldier with a bloody limb. The team's overnight investigation yields shocking findings, including direct contact with a paranormal presence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS calls in Bruce Tango, father of Dave Tango, to help investigate a place close to his heart, the Union County Courthouse, a historic property in Elizabeth, NJ, Over the years, many staff members have reported phones ringing without anyone on the lines and seeing apparitions roaming the halls who is known to be of Hannah Coldwell or the four men who died at the hands of capital punishment, who haunt the halls of these historic building.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has received an urgent call for help from a Chicago community center whose patrons are being chased away by a variety of menacing spirits. The Benton House is a historic set of two buildings that have served the city of Chicago for a century. Through the years, a number of residents have expired on the property from devastating illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Thousand Island, NY to investigate a 4-acre private island and is joined by the " King of Rock and Roll" himself, Meatloaf. The 4-acre private island owned by the Claudia family houses a four-story, ten-bedroom mansion and a three-story, seven-bedroom boathouse. The immediate family of six resides in the boathouse while the mansion serves as guest quarters for visitors. The property has been in the family for fifty years and has always had a haunted history.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship. The USS Salem spent decades sailing the oceans of the world as a witness to untold death and damage. In 1953, a large earthquake struck the Ionian Islands in Greece, completely devastating the communities and killing hundreds. The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of arrogant local beauty Melissa Townsend is discovered by the pool at her manor house, DCI Barnaby uncovers a seedy world of adultery and deceit within the affluent rural community.

programme.desc: When the leader of a reading club used as a cover to run an investment portfolio is found battered to death, the club's secret activities are exposed and long-held secrets and desires return to haunt its members.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Cannellini pesto dip and a crudite spread; spaghetti primavera with courgette, green beans, peas and asparagus; spinach, bread and ricotta frittata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is a party in the air with an Italian flair. Lidia teaches the viewer several dishes that will work for any party - including a selection of varies cheese, cured meat and Giardiniera Style Vegetables; an easy and quick Sweet and Sour Zucchini Dish and lastly Stuffed Mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers and fresh parsley. Lastly there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels and calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Whether used in soups, roasted or stuffed, the Italians love their vegetables. In this episode, she makes a platter full of Roasted Peppers Stuffed with Tuna. She then creates a mellow dish of Savory Onions Stuffed with Lamb and Sweet Raisins. The Cauliflower and Tomato Soup is one that warms the heart and any kitchen table.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey in celebration of life's milestones, sharing in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food. Milestones include sweet sixteen, baptism, graduation, and a house blessing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in today's episode! With a little bit of prep time and a hot oven, you can enjoy the appetizers with the friends and family while the rest is baking. Today's recipes include: Spicy Stuffed Clams; Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate; and Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage & Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled corn, courgette and tomato salad; spicy lobster linguine.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Entertaining comes in many forms, and today Lidia creates a menu that is perfect for an intimate gathering of friends and family. This simply elegant dinner menu includes Swordfish alla Bagnara, a delicately steamed swordfish made with an aromatic mix of lemon, capers and garlic - a traditional dish from the Calabrian town of Bagnara. She'll then do a spicy Bloody Mary, followed by a classic Lagane e Ceci - ribbons of fresh pasta made with chickpeas and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italy is a garden year round, and Lidia celebrates an array of beautiful vegetable dishes including: Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; an elegant Asparagus and Scallion Salad; a refreshing Fava Sesame Dip, that pairs beautifully with flat breads and finally a Linguine with Swisschard made with walnuts and creamy fresh ricotta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are perfect for entertaining and include a savory Onion-Tomato Focaccia, restaurant inspired spreads for fresh bread and Skillet or Grilled Calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even to stuff. Lidia begins by making a Classic Rosemary and Lemon Focaccia; she then moves on to a Filled Focaccia with Smoky Speck and Fontina Cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a Salad of Shrimp, Fava and Cranberry Beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on today in Lidia's Kitchen, and she is sharing some of her best cakes. There is a Gianduia Cake - a Piedmontese tradition and a dream for hazelnut and chocolate lovers; a delicious and moist Chocolate and Zucchini Cake; and finally a nutty Walnut and Espresso Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her all-time favorites - Tomato and Onion Salad alla Calabrese, a great salad to make in the summer when tomatoes are sweet and ripe. Everyone loves meatballs, and Lidia shows viewers how to use leftovers in a Leftover Meatball Panini. Finally, Lidia stuffs Pizza Rolls with broccoli rabe and sausage and with ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She spent a lot of time with chickens, as she would tend to them and gather their eggs. In this episode, Lidia recollects those fond memories and creates a medley of vegetables, salumi, cheese and hard boiled eggs for her Chopped Salad with Frisee and Fennel. She also prepares a Chicken Cacciatore as well as a Potato and Egg Frico.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Steamed broccoli, cannellini and egg salad; skillet tuna with aubergine and courgette in puttanesca sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Whether it's American football or Italian soccer, game day parties are always popular. Lidia believes that there is nothing like a bountiful spread of food that will fuel the guests and get them cheering. On today's menu, she serves Fried Mozzarella Sandwich Skewers; Carrot and Chickpea Dip and Pizza Rolls - made with both broccoli rabe and sausage AND ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The stove can do a lot of work in any home kitchen, and many recipes can be created simultaneously. In this episode, Lidia shares recipes for: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta; Ziti with Kale and Crispy Bacon; and Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Tomatoes are known in the Italian culture although the tradition goes way beyond the simple tomato sauce. Lidia gathers some of her favorite tomato based recipes and shares them in this episode including: Tomato and Mint Salad, Tomato and Ricotta Crostini, Spaghetti with Quick Pantry Sauce. She finishes with a Gluttonous Tomato- a perfect appetizer or lunch dish starring oven baked tomatoes stuffed with bread, grated cheese and seasoning and topped with farm eggs. Yum!
programme.sub-title: The Versatile Tomato and All things Italian

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Butternut squash and cannellini beans; a quick and easy dessert of strawberries and balsamic; roasted spaghetti squash with spicy tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Spices impart a lot of flavor to a recipe, and today Lidia shows viewers how to use different spices. First on the menu is Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, an elegant and luxurious way to serve mussels. Lidia loves peperoncino in almost any dish, especially when making Spicy Stuffed Clams. And finally, Lidia makes Chicken and Zucchini Salad with Horseradish Dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter always proved to be a tough time for the garden, but this only made cold weather crops more valuable on Lidia's family table. Recipes in this episode include a delicious Orecchiette with Breadcrumbs, Pancetta, and Cauliflower, and a unique and flavorful Cabbage Salad topped with a warm dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing better than a great piece of meat! In today's episode, Lidia takes a less expensive cut, London Broil, and marinate it to perfection. Her menu includes a delicious Vegetable Patty served with green salad which works as an appetizer or by itself as a quick lunch, London Broil with Sun Dried Tomato Marinade and one of her Grandma Rosa's favorite Corn and Walnut Cake

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the sea growing up near the Adriatic's beautiful rocky beaches. Fishing trips with Uncle Emilio were always a lot of hard work, but definitely worth the delicious reward. Today, she prepares a Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis, Toasted Bread with Basil Cannellini, and a Whole Roasted Branzino where everything is done in the oven for a trouble-free cleanup.
programme.sub-title: Fishing the Adriatic with Uncle Emilio

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh pasta is an Italian family tradition passed through the generations. Today she starts with a silky pappardelle pasta dressed with pesto made from walnut, basil and parsley. She then takes the same pasta dough and shapes it into Tortelloni stuffed with spinach and ricotta, dressed with a classic marinara sauce.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Return of the Artisans Season 1
programme.desc: Lidia Bastianich travels the country to meet with American makers who are mastering the art of meat curing, coopering, coppersmithing, jam-making, cider-making, and more-and finds out what inspires and fuels them. She sees how artisanal crafts and small businesses are a fulfilling way to earn a livelihood, and how many craftspeople are bringing their skills back to their own communities.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Return of the Artisans

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing more delicious than butterflied poultry with super crispy chicken. In this episode, Lidia starts with a Spicy Butterflied Cornish Hen made with hot cherry peppers, rosemary and wine. She then pulls out the beer to add to her Potatoes Baked in Beer .Our favorite Grandma Erminia joins Lidia to taste the Squash and Ricotta Tart.
programme.sub-title: A Little Spice With A Hint of Beer

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's first home economics class as a teenager in New York confirmed her passion for food. Despite the differences compared to what she was used to, she was determined to explore it all. Lidia starts off with Lasagna with Ricotta and Mozzarella, a dish she remembers from when she was first introduced to Italian American food. She follows this with a flavorful Escarole Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes, and finishes with Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a very satisfying mixture.
programme.sub-title: Cooking as a Kid in New York

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join beloved chef and cookbook author Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey to four celebrations of independence, to share in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and back in the kitchen, Lidia shares her favorite cheesy appetizers - Baked Goat Cheese, Fava, and Artichoke Dip, baked to golden to perfection; and Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a recipe Lidia often makes when cooking for her family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When a holiday or special occasion goes around, it's time to go above and beyond with an extra special feast. Today, Lidia shares some of her best recipes to do just that. Her Wedding Soup is a classic Italian dish that marries the vegetables and meatballs in a delicious pot of soup; Prosecco Punch, made with raspberries and nectarines is a real crowd pleaser, and finally you can't go wrong with a beautiful Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Carrots and Parsnips, a rich and flavorful one pot meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has always loved trips to the food market. From her days as a small child preparing to go to the market with her grandmother to searching for seasonal produce today, it has always been an adventure. Recipes in this episode include a Shrimp, Roasted Pepper and Olive Salad and a delicious vegetarian Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Olive oil is an essential staple in every Italian home. It's the easiest way to add flavor to any soup, and Lidia shows you how when making Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup. Olive oil is also used in desserts, and she makes Olive Oil Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are dedicated to the family. They can be made for a weeknight dinner or a large gathering or holiday and include: Oven Braised Pork Chops with Red Onion and Pears; Cherry Jam Tart. To start, Lidia enjoys a special Cherry Bellini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shows you how to brunch Italian-style. On the menu are Herb Frittata Roll-Ups, a wonderful appetizer to pass around at a cocktail party or for a buffet brunch; Pancetta with Fennel-Flavored Eggs and Apples, a delicious breakfast or brunch dish served with lots of crusty bread; and Potato and Egg Frico, a favorite breakfast dish in Lidia's family, in which potatoes and cheese are baked together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a teenager in the seventies, Lidia was always curious about Italian-American cuisine, which was extremely popular especially in New York City and all the boroughs. Today she honors the Italian-American culinary culture and prepares a Chicken Parmigiana Light, a leftover Meatball Panino, and a Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs, and Eggs, which will be sure to leave everyone satisfied.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about stress-free cooking for a holiday celebration or special occasion. Lidia makes Marinated Mushrooms that can be part of an antipasto spread or as a nibble with drinks. Vin Brûlé, the Italian version of mulled wine, is a warm and welcoming drink to make for any holiday celebration. Last on the menu is Turkey Breast with Apricots, an easy and quick way to serve turkey without having to cook a whole turkey.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: They have been called the "gnocchi family", and in this episode, Lidia shares two of her more unusual versions of this dish: Her Butternut Squash Gnocchi are light and slightly sweet as they showcase this welcome vegetable in the potato mix. Her next dish is Plum Gnocchi, which is typical of her homeland and even sweeter, sometimes eaten as a dessert. Made with toasted breadcrumbs, cinnamon and butter, it doesn't get any better than this!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's an episode devoted to the fresh, simple egg, and it highlights some of Lidia's all-time favorites: Stracciatella: a simple chicken stock laced with ribbons of egg and tender spinach; Frittata with Ricotta: a luscious frittata filled with ricotta, tomatoes, onions and basil; Baked Eggplant and Eggs: a baked dish showing off of one of summer's best vegetables.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their crepes either savory or sweet and this episode, Lidia shows two of her favorite crespelle dishes, along with some great chef tips. She will start by highlighting the thin pancakes that can be made into so many things; then she'll make a savory Italian favorite with them - Manicotti and for a sweet version, she will show the Chocolate and Walnut Crespelle that will satisfy any sweet tooth.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia says that the key to a great party is always the food, and in this episode she features some of her best party recipes from over the years. Bruschetta is always a great snack to pass around, and the combinations are endless. Her Fig & Prosciutto Bruschetta is a unique and delicious party item that she includes at almost any gathering. She'll also prepare a colorful Marinated Winter Squash that is a favorite at her home parties.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads.to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joing her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, the oven is on for the fish dish, the vegetable dish and for the chicken drumsticks! Lidia creates three great main course ideas that are just right for days when you want to do everything in one dish and put it in the oven until it's ready to serve. She makes a Baked Fennel with Tomatoes and oozing Cheese. She then creates a Rollatini of Sole with flavored breadcrumbs baked in a light and delicate sauce of fresh herbs, lemon and white wine.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: A Salute to First Responders Season 1
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich travels the country visiting men and women who've worked quietly in the shadows and now find themselves thrust into the spotlight by crises facing the country in 2020. From coast to coast, Lidia follows dedicated police officers, firefighters, paramedics, military and medical workers, and observes the prominent role that food plays in these first responders' lives.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: A Salute to First Responders

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.desc: Saddle up for Southern charm as Chef Walter Staib rides through Nashville's history at Belle Meade Mansion. Explore the melodic roots of Country Music, visit iconic landmarks, and whip up delicious Southern eats like Country ham, fruitcake, and syllabub. Experience Nashville's rich cultural heritage and culinary delights in this captivating journey.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - History, Horses, & Hospitality | Nashville, Tennessee

programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Rice & Resilience | Charleston, South Carolina

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: The Breakfast Show: Whether you're hosting guests or seeking a reason to get out of bed, this show amps up your breakfast game by firing up the grill. First, a spectacular breakfast pizza. Next, a supremely satisfying grilled vegetable frittata. Finally, the most outrageous cinnamon rolls we've ever tasted from executive chef Russel Cunningham of St. Louis' Union Station.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Breakfast Show

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Raichen's Rules: Seafood: Seventy percent of the earth is covered with water and yet, the combination of live fire and seafood can be a grillers worst nightmare. For this season's Raichlen's Rules, we've decided to ease your anxiety. A lot of people are intimidated by the prospect of grilling seafood, but by strategically picking the method, fire can make the bounty of the sea wondrous.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Raichlen's Rules: Seafood

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Game Day Grill: No one knows what spectators ate at the first Olympic games, held in ancient Greece in 776 BCE, but today's sports fans and grill fanatics like to celebrate their obsession with a barbecue. Tailgating favorites come hot off the grill in this episode as we tackle Project Fire Rib Wings, Buffalo Brisket Burnt Ends, and a Balkan Mixed Grill with some special guests.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Game Day Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Sandwiches Hit the Grill: It's a simple formula: bread + protein + condiment, but it adds up to a triple decker of pleasure. In today's show, the sandwich hits the grill. From a glorious BLT made with home cured and smoked bacon, to pan bagnat-a magisterial grilled tuna sandwich inspired by the French Cote d'Azur. And then it's a sandwich for dessert in a Project Fire mystery box.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Sandwiches Hit the Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Grill: Physicians have long extolled the virtues of the Mediterranean diet. Today the healthy foods and vibrant flavors of the Mediterranean hit the grill when Steven grills Sicilian grilled artichokes and branzino stuffed with fennel stalks. Then there's Greek grilled baby lamb chops with ember roasted potatoes prepared by friend and host of My Greek Table, Diane Kochilas.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Mediterranean Grill

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: For many, barbecue means meat. But you may be surprised to learn that one of the earliest recorded barbecues featured fish wrapped in grape leaves. Today Steven begins with saffron-scented Catalan shrimp kebabs, followed by trout Mexican style with a sizzling garlic cilantro sauce. Then there's a Mystery Box that will astonish you as much as it surprised Steven.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Water Meets Fire

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Wagyu Demystified: Wagyu, "Japanese cow" literally, was once an obscure cattle breed from Japan. Today, it's on restaurant menus and in butcher shops around the world. Get ready for a sumptuous Japanese A5 Rib-Eye with sesame salt and grilled rice cakes, followed by wagyu steak tomahawks with fire-roasted marrow. Then feast your eyes on wagyu smash burgers with parmesan crisps.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wagyu Demystified

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Influential Grilling: Scroll through the images on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, and you'll find grilled and smoked dishes of astonishing ingenuity. In the spirit of this new style of barbecue, we've invited three of my favorite influencers to grill with me - Derek Wolf from Over the Fire Cooking, Scott Thomas from Grillin' Fools, and Susie Bulloch from Hey Grill Hey.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Influential Grilling

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Chef Stellino shares his sauce making secrets, to inspire the viewers with this elegant and sophisticated Mango and Ginger sauce that is easy to make and tastes delicious! He also shares some important fact about the uniqueness of the Black cod and his step by step secrets on how to plate this dish with the refined elegance of a professional chef.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Black Cod with Mango and Ginger Sauce and Sautéed Green Beans

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Meatloaf when done right can be a work of art, something worthy of the finest restaurant. It is all about technique and it is never hard to do right. Chef Stellino re-interprets for his viewers a fabulous Sicilian recipe from his youth and in the process he shares with them a series of foolproof techniques for getting done right every time.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Stuffed Meatloaf and Cake with Rum Sauce!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Cooking the perfect pork chop and preparing the ultimate sauce with port and Gorgonzola is a easy as 1-2-3! Making the perfect ricotta cheesecake is even easier. Chef Stellino loves to share his tips and techniques with a passionate delivery and easy to follow instructions.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Chops with Port & Gorgonzola Sauce and Ricotta Cheesecake

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: How not to overcook shrimp!! Chef Stellino guides the viewer though a series of tips and techniques on how to make incredibly flavorful shrimp recipes which are fool proof and look and taste like a million dollars.
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Sizzling Shrimp Dishes

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: Some call this the ultimate dinner, a perfectly cooked NY steak with a Vodka martini sauce! Chef Stellino once again shares all of his secrets in the making a an iconic sauce , the perfect accompaniment to the king of steaks: The New York. Then to sum it all up he shares with us a lusciously sweet, easy to make dessert of pears braised with Marsala!
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Ultimate Steak Dinner

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino
programme.desc: A soup can be a form of art! Chef Stellino shares his secrets for the perfect soups, smooth , luscious and elegant. Plus he shows the viewers a series of simple techniques to create elegant topping to dress it all up. Simple clear instructions with step by step demonstrations on how to get it done in one try!
programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Luscious Soups!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino

programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Grilled Shrimp with Peppers and Tuna with Tomato Salad

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino

programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Pork Chops and Pineapple Upside-down Cake

Then, they perform a Roman hat trick - three pastas starting with the same delicious base: Gricia made with guanciale transforms into Amatriciana by adding tomatoes or Carbonara by adding eggs. In her own kitchen, Sara makes baked penne with prosciutto and Fontina cheese.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals

Fried meat filled pizza may be even better than that, or is the best one a unique star shaped pizza? Just across the bay in Sorrento it's all lemons, all the time as Sara visits a proud family of lemon growers. They make a citrus flecked cheese and Grandma's Lemon Pasta.

To prove the point Sara's got two recipes: a French Onion Soup Burger topped with melty, gooey cheese and an equally gooey Alsatian Onion Pie with caramelized onions and melted Gruyere that puts it over the top. Later, we visit a dairy farm and then on 'Ask Sara', an easy homemade ricotta.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara's strategy for easy weeknight cooking? Simply cook a dish one night, then repurpose it into a different meal for another night. Maya Kaimal joins Sara to make Turkey Keema with sweet potatoes and ground meat. On another night, that morphs into Indian stuffed peppers. Then Sara Sautee's Duck Breasts for a quick meal. She uses those same Duck Breasts in a mouthwatering Peking Duck Wrap.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Weeknight Two for One

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals

programme.desc: Three new ideas from a simple pot of rice. Then we'll see the wine country from the Napa Valley Wine Train.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa
programme.desc: Simple dishes show off the flavor of new peas and asparagus. We'll make a Cheater's Chicken Stock (when there's no homemade stock on hand), a bright green Spring Pea Soup, a quick, tender and lemony Peas and Cipolline dish, and Halibut with Asparagus and Salsa Genovese. We'll see the vineyards of the wine country covered in golden mustard blossoms, and drop in on the Mustard Festival.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. A ten-minute technique for making olives bright and lively, homemade mozzarella, which we serve en carrozza - in a "carriage" of bread dipped in egg and anchovies - and turkey polpettone filled with a center of melting cheese. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa
programme.desc: Discover a lemon marinade and other secrets for preparing artichoke hearts. We'll sear a sea bass and make an artichoke salad with red onions, kalamata olives, lemons, and other Mediterranean flavors. We'll cook baby lamb chops and artichokes and serve them with a creamy, tangy egg-lemon sauce. And we'll cross the hill to see the other food and wine-loving valley, Sonoma.
programme.sub-title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Surf or Turf

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa
programme.desc: Soup makes a meal and, with a few techniques, becomes a sauce the next day for fish, poultry or meat. Summer Corn Soup, served warm or cold, makes a beautiful yellow sauce for scallops. Tart apples and sweet butternut squash make a soup that becomes a full-bodied sauce for pork chops. We'll visit a ghost winery and meet some third-generation California winemakers.
programme.sub-title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Zuppe, Zuppe, Zuppe

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa
programme.desc: Our favorite pantry secret stays in your freezer. Compound butters are flavored with fresh herbs and spices, rolled into logs, and kept cold to retain all their flavor. We'll make a Garlic Thyme Butter, a Basil Chive Butter for steak, bruschetta or corn, and a Bagna Cauda Butter for fresh clams and pasta. And we'll visit some of the architectural gems of the Napa Valley.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa

programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet's most biologically rich and complex regions. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet's temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Carol Klein and Nick Bailey celebrate gardeners throughout the country who have created some truly unique gardens and made every space count. Carol meets a couple in Dorset whose garden is full of inspirational features.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is at Longmeadow, enjoying the colours of late summer in the garden. Adam Frost, Carol Klein and Frances Tophill get an exclusive preview of Gardeners' World Live at the NEC.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is at Longmeadow with plenty of seasonal advice to keep gardens colourful. Will Young shows off his south London courtyard garden and reveals why it has become an absolute joy in his life, and Joe Swift helps him create some seasonal pot displays for sunny and shady spots.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels from Missouri to Chicago and then across to New York and Philadelphia. He begins his journey in a prairie, the original American flowering wilderness. Much of the prairie has disappeared, but he meets a couple who have revived the tradition and enjoy showing it to him in full bloom.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty goes South to explore gardens of early independent America and learns how the history of this part of the country is still very much evident in the places and people he meets. He visits the famous garden where President Thomas Jefferson, one of America's founding fathers, enjoyed spending his time seeking out seeds and plants for his thousand-foot vegetable garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty explores the extraordinary scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty sows rocket, harvests chillies and tomatoes, and demonstrates how to take semi-ripe cuttings. Frances Tophill meets a head gardener in south London who's started gardening sustainably.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost is in his garden, bringing viewers up to date on how it has been developing, as well as giving advice on growing hydrangeas. Toby Buckland shares his tips on dealing with damaged shrubs, tree pruning and transplanting perennials.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don and Nigel make the most of the season and prepare for the winter ahead. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is in Surrey looking at wild and cultivated heathers.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice, but can Monty set them on the right track?

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team are in Daresbury in Chester with downsizers, Karen and Alan. The couple have a small, wedge-shaped garden with so little in it that the only thing to look at is the fences, but those fences don't even provide privacy from the neighbours.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team visit Bernadette, a dedicated social worker for troubled adults who has always put the needs of others before her own. Having recently turned sixty, Bernadette finally wants some 'me time': a new garden could give her a well-deserved reward.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team have an unusual challenge: to turn a long, pointed front garden into a water-saving, wildlife-friendly space. Mum Laura wants a place to encourage the bugs and creepy-crawlies that young son William loves.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Salford, the team meet Nicole, who grew up in Germany. She wants to recreate her family's German 'kleine' garden, a traditional community space divided into fruit, veg and lawn.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is back at Longmeadow, getting stuck into more seasonal tasks. Joe Swift heads to Houghton Lodge Gardens in Hampshire renowned for its walled kitchen garden and heritage fruit collection.

programme.desc: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Exploring the reasons piracy endures from ancient times until today; why it is so difficult to both define and eradicate; how one can understand the rule of law and the rights of nations and individuals on the high seas and in borderless realms.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Examining popular pirate legends; discovering which aspects include some truth and which contain none at all; pirate literature can teach a lot about the Jolly Roger, gold-filled treasure chests, the pirate Edward Thatch and more.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: How the Spanish's power hold on the Caribbean is broken; which nationalities join in the free-for-all; the historical importance of Alexander Exquemelin's "Buccaneers of America" and Captain Charles Johnson's "A General History of the Pyrates".

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Pirates want money or anything they can turn into money; consequently, they usually wish for a speedy surrender, do not want a battle and rarely sink captured ships; the many tactics pirates use to apprehend their prey in the age of sails.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Very few pirates hit it big or try to bury their treasure on a deserted island; exploring the business aspect of piracy, which is one of the few aspects of life pirates can control; piracy is a no-prey, no-pay system; the risk of no pay is very real.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: Some of the ways people think about the American West; how this vast, fascinating region comes into being; how it is shaped by centuries of myth-making; what about westward expansion fascinates every generation of Americans.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians.
programme.sub-title: The West in the Colonial Era

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: After the Revolutionary War, the land between the Appalachians and the Mississippi becomes part of the new republic; how the territory is organized; the Northwest Ordinance of 1787 creates a new set of rules that clashes with old realities.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: The journey of the two explorers who map the Louisiana Purchase between 1804 and 1806; how Lewis and Clark fit into the tradition of explorers looking for a water route to the Pacific; the political and geographic history of the Louisiana Purchase.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: Fur traders and mountain men play an integral part in exploring and mapping the American West; why fur is a precious commodity; how John Jacob Astor dominates the American fur trade; how famous mountaineers like Jedediah Smith become legends.
programme.sub-title: The Fur Trade and the Mountain Men

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: One of the most dismal episodes in the story of the American West; the forced migration of the "Five Civilized Tribes" under the Indian Removal Act of 1830; it is this ordeal that the Cherokee come to call the "Trail of Tears".

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: The experiences of Julia, the daughter of Caesar Augustus; a window into the way many pre-modern societies sought to control morality; Julia's life of thwarted potential; understanding what women had to overcome to make a mark on history.

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: The portrayal of the John the Baptist's death as the whim of the young femme fatale Salome; why the truth is much more complicated; the story of Salome's mother, Herodias; how Herodias's hunger for power and recognition left her exiled and forgotten.
programme.sub-title: Herodias Has John the Baptist Beheaded

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: China under the Han Dynasty; how imperial expansion threatened the matriarchal culture of Vietnam; the Trung sisters; leading tribal armies against the invaders; how the Trung sisters' story has become a touchstone of Vietnamese culture.
programme.sub-title: The Trung Sisters of Vietnam Fight the Han

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: The end of Iron Age Britain and the birth of Roman Britain; the valiant but thwarted rebellion of the Celtic warrior queen, Boudicca; how Boudicca was motivated by personal tragedy; the revival of Boudicca's legacy by Queen Victoria.

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: Nero's reputation for excess and cruelty; how Poppaea became the wife of the mad emperor; how Poppaea's religious sympathies likely influenced Nero's persecution of Christians; a complex story of spiritual zeal and vicious cruelty.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Asking whether genes determine one's essential nature and identity, or one builds their own identity; exploring the essentialist and constructed philosophies; how one might incorporate aspects of both into their own view of personal identity.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Labs that provide DNA ancestry information use hundreds of thousands of ancestry-information markers, or AIMs; learning about the AIMs that relate to major identifiable lineages; what can be gleaned from mitochondrial DNA and Y-DNA.
programme.sub-title: What Genetic Testing Brings to Ancestry

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: There are many social issues affecting an individual's emotional response to receiving DNA ancestry results; how the reciprocal engagement method can help families face unexpected ancestry results; tips to consider before ordering one's own test.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: People want a family narrative, whereas DNA just "wants" to move itself forward and is neutral on issues of race, subterfuge or social connection; how to create a strategic family narrative to incorporate the scientific facts of DNA ancestry results.
programme.sub-title: When Family Narrative Meets Genetic Testing

programme.title: King Arthur: History and Legend
programme.desc: Studying images of the Arthurian legend and their relationship to historical reality; tracing the history of post-Roman Britain; the large-scale invasions of the Anglo-Saxons; evidence that a single individual rose up to lead his people.

programme.title: King Arthur: History and Legend
programme.desc: Investigating archeological and historical evidence that supports the existence of an Arthur-like figure in early Britain; studying the site of Cadbury Castle, the center of operations of a leader who thwarted the Saxons; the supposed tomb of Arthur.

programme.title: King Arthur: History and Legend
programme.desc: Exploring some of the most significant early witnesses to the Arthurian legend; studying accounts of Arthur's exploits and death in Latin texts and the Welsh Annales Cambriae; how texts from the 11th and 12th century C.E. embellished the legend.
programme.sub-title: King Arthur in the Latin Chronicles

programme.title: King Arthur: History and Legend

programme.sub-title: King Arthur in Wales - The Mabinogion

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: Scholars who have devoted their lives to studying the ancient sources about Jesus come to varying conclusions; seeing what can be learned about what Jesus most likely says and does by working from a strictly historical perspective.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: Beginning the study of the historical Jesus by examining the world within which the Christian religion is born; this world is largely populated by "pagans" who, unlike the Jews and then later the Christians, believe not in one but in many gods.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: The work of German writer D. F. Strauss argues that the Gospels are best understood as containing history-like stories that intend to convey truth but do not occur as they are narrated, which is why most scholars find his approach illuminating.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: Scholars question the historical accuracy of some gospel accounts not out of hostility toward Christianity, but because of historical evidence; what this evidence is; how historians assess it.

programme.title: Hard Target

They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.
