programme.desc: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.

programme.title: Man With The Gun
programme.desc: As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what's left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programme.title: Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

programme.title: Michael Cimino's Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This lavish, epic western retells the true story of Wyoming's infamous Johnson County War, a brutal, late 19th century conflict during which wealthy cattlemen, backed by the U.S. government, hired mercenaries to murder 125 immigrant settlers.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory - and a cunning woman - to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

programme.title: Southwest Passage
programme.desc: Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Gary Cooper gives a marvelous, tongue-in-cheek performance as a fumble-fingered cowpoke who is mistaken for a notorious bandit and almost gets killed by both sides of the law...all while managing to capture the attention of Loretta Young.

programme.title: Man Of The West
programme.desc: Screen legend Gary Cooper demonstrates why he will always be remembered as one of the most authentic stars of the screen. Capable yet vulnerable, Cooper's portrayal of a former outlaw whose past returns to haunt him ranks among his very best.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that's a fiesta of fun.

programme.title: Invitation To A Gunfighter
programme.desc: Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner, who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
programme.desc: Two New York detectives suddenly find themselves on a wild goose chase for stolen cash that takes them from the Apollo Theater through the heart and soul of Harlem!

programme.title: Beat Street
programme.desc: Feel the rhythm. Catch the beat! Brash, bold and breakin' all the rules, this powerful musical stars Rae Dawn Chong and Guy Davis.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: A straight-laced and successful executive's world is turned upside-down when he discovers the 17-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington in his feature film debut)!

programme.title: A Family Thing
programme.desc: When Earl (Robert Duvall) learns he has a Black half-brother (James Earl Jones) in Chicago, he heads north.

programme.title: What's The Worst That Could Happen?
programme.desc: Martin Lawrence and Danny DeVito escalate a battle of egos to epic proportions in this hilarious comedy.

programme.title: Barbershop (2002)
programme.desc: Ice Cube headlines a stellar cast this hit comedy about a southside Chicago barbershop.

programme.title: Barbershop 2: Back In Business
programme.desc: Calvin (Ice Cube) is struggling to keep his father's shop alive, competing with a name-brand chain next door!

programme.title: Beauty Shop
programme.desc: When her egotistical boss pushes her a hair too far, top stylist Gina decides to open her own beauty shop!

programme.title: Soul Plane
programme.desc: An all star comedy cast are ready to board the newest airline -- one that gives "fly" a whole new meaning!

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Struggling actor Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) dreams of landing a role, but soon learns you have to "dream" up your own roles. Keenen Ivory Wayans and Anne-Marie Johnson also star.

programme.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
programme.desc: A slick comedy that blows the 70s Blaxploitation movies right out of the hood! A decorated war hero, returns to the ghetto and enlist an army of original gangstas to clean it up in this mixture of nostalgia, silliness and unpredictable humor.

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: When a Jewish tailor (Zero Mostel) decides to give up on God, a mysterious man (Harry Belafonte) appears, claiming to be his Jewish guardian angel!

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: When wild child Anna Lucasta (Eartha Kitt) is thrown out of the house by her self-righteous father, she falls into the life of prostitution... and into the arms of street-wise sailor Danny Johnson (Sammy Davis, Jr.).

programme.title: Salt & Pepper
programme.desc: Legendary Rat-Packers Sammy Davis, Jr., and Peter Lawford star as London's hippest nightclub owners who take on England's craziest criminals!

programme.title: Bojangles
programme.desc: Bill "Bojangles" Robinson (Gregory Hines) overcomes the prejudice of the time and his own personal demons to become a master craftsman...and a legendary entertainer!

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, the black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. Three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and tough cop Rita Rizzoli is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia intenta despedirse de Tomás y se arrepiente de haberlo lastimado; Aldo entrega Conceptos a sus verdaderos dueños.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety prepara todo para su boda con Fernando; Tomás y Alicia deciden reanudar su relación; la tan esperada boda de los protagonistas.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety se presenta a una entrevista de trabajo en Conceptos, una casa productora, para ser secretaria ejecutiva, pero compite con la bella pero inexperta Alicia.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando y Marcia tienen conflictos por la contratación de Leticia, y Marcia le pide a Fernando una explicación; en el fondo, a Marcia le preocupa que Lety esté tan bien preparada.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando les asigna a Lety y Alicia sus funciones en la empresa: Lety se encargará del papeleo y Alicia de las relaciones públicas.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Bajo las órdenes de Fernando, Simón le pide perdón a Lety por molestarla. Fernando regaña a Lety por dejar la agenda personal descuidada y le da indicaciones.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando se entera de que López despide a Lety y decide ir a salvarla, por lo que se enfurece con Marcia y amenaza a López con despedirlo.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Román deja plantada a Lety, quien escucha que Fernando se casará con Marcia. Paula María y Jaimito van a la oficina. Simón le pide perdón a Lety.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety recibe y ordena la información de los ejecutivos de Conceptos, pero Alicia se lleva los créditos tras apropiarse del informe que realizó Lety.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety recibe el comentario de que Fernando es un don Juan, y la advertencia de que no se enamore. Ariel encuentra errores en la propuesta de Fernando para tener la presidencia.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando le pide a Alicia elaborar un trabajo especial, pero ella no sabe cómo resolverlo. Lety trabaja fuertemente en el plan de trabajo de Fernando, pero lo pierde en el transporte público.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia le dice a Fernando que no hizo el trabajo que le pidió. Cuco y Adriana descubren que el CD que encontraron es de Lety. Omar se niega a ayudar a Alicia a preparar el plan de negocios. Don Erasmo llega a Conceptos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety tiene un malentendido con Fernando, y cree que la despidieron. Lola le reclama a Efrén por su pensión.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando le pide a Lety acompañarlo a la junta con Ariel; Tomás le dice a don Erasmo que su hija es secretaria; Ariel se burla porque Leticia estará en la junta de ejecutivos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia necesita una cita con Ariel para celar a Omar. Paula María invita a Lety a salir con amigos. Fernando está en casa de Marcia, aburrido decide ir algún lugar a bailar, Marcia se queda. Lety y Fernando se encuentran en el antro y bailan juntos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando decide pasar la noche con Marcia en su apartamento; Don Erasmo reprende a Lety por salir sin permiso.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Marcia se niega a comunicar a Lety con Fernando porque está concursando en el hipódromo; Lety obliga a Simón a llevarla al club para hablar con Fernando de inmediato.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia le cuenta a Marcia cómo la humillaron las otras secretarias y sobre el nombramiento de Lety; Marcia le reclama a Fernando por el ascenso de su secretaria.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Olarte le dice a Ariel que Fernando es capaz de maquillar el balance que presentará en la junta del comité; Ariel se le insinúa a Alicia y ella se molesta, pero igual lo usa para poner celoso a Omar.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: El ingeniero Ortiz le dice a Olarte que Lety bloqueó el acceso a los archivos; la niña que iba a grabar el comercial se enferma, Lola aprovecha la oportunidad y le sugiere a Irma usar a Adrianita.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety no hace las copias de seguridad y la computadora se descompone, no hay forma de presentar el balance. El ingeniero Ortiz le comunica al Comité los problemas con la computadora de Lety. Ariel reprende a Lety por no tener respaldo de sus archivos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety se integra a la junta del Comité para explicar el balance financiero de Conceptos. Lety da una explicación detallada y logra rebatir todas las objeciones y dudas de Ariel respecto a la buena situación de la empresa.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: El club casi descubre al responsable de lo sucedido con la computadora de Lety; Lety está más cerca de ser vicepresidenta financiera.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Omar deja a Paula María en un bar; un zapato de Lety se cae en una fuente; Ariel le pide a Alicia informarle todo lo que pase en Conceptos; Fernando le pide a Lety supervisar la compra de unas cámaras de video.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Marcia le da a Alicia un cheque para pagar la luz y el gas; Fernando le pide a Luigi usar otra cámara mientras llega la de cine, pero él se niega; Marcia se molesta porque Fernando autorizará la firma de Lety en los bancos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia decide no salir con Omar; Lety convence a Fernando de que Cine Rent es la mejor opción; Ariel llega al departamento de Alicia; Omar se encuentra a Paula María y le ofrece llevarla a su casa.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia escucha a Fernando contarle a Marcia del contrato con Cine Rent y se lo dice a Ariel; Fernando le cuenta a Miguel que Lety lo convenció para aceptar su propuesta.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le pide a Lety no aceptar la comisión que le ofrecieron, pues sería un soborno y cuestionaría su honestidad. Lety le cuenta a Fernando acerca de la comisión que le ofrecieron en Cine Rent y él a su vez, se lo cuenta a Marcia.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Carolina critica a Fernando y Omar por burlarse de la fealdad de Lety; Luigi se molesta al ver sus bocetos pintarrajeados; Lola le pide a Simón que se lleve a los niños y que tire las evidencias que los delaten.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando supervisa la recepción de Beni; Marcia le dice a Fernando que Fabiola y Gregorio tienen parados los nuevos foros por problemas con los clientes de los comerciales.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Luigi se molesta porque Fernando le entrega una cámara de video en vez de una de 35 milímetros que le pidió; el Club de las Feas decide festejar que Lety se quedará como presidenta de Conceptos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Carolina le dice a Fernando lo que acordó con la prensa; las secretarias del Club de las Feas se desilusionan cuando descubren que Rolando es el novio de Luigi; Arturo le cancela a Fernando el contrato con la disquera.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando, Marcia y Omar van a Los Ángeles a cerrar un contrato. Lety y sus amigas se van de antro y terminan borrachas.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety autoriza que Cuco, Adrianita, Jaimito y Clarita se queden en Conceptos; los niños encuentran unos carteles y deciden hacer una mezcla; Martha y Sara retienen el cheque de pago de Alicia.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Fernando por qué no contrató a las modelos; Fernando le reclama a Lety haber permitido que los niños se quedaran en la empresa; Fernando le pide a Luigi que regrese a trabajar.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando acuerda los términos de contratación con las modelos y con Luigi; Fátima llega en busca de Fernando; Paula María se encuentra con López; Omar le aconseja a Fernando seducir a Fátima.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Simón llega al bar por Paula María y deja empeñado su reloj para pagar la cuenta; Simón intenta hacerle ver a Paula María cuánto la quiere y ella le da un beso.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Marcia llega a Conceptos y todos van a quejarse con ella; Alicia protesta por cómo la tratan las del club y Luigi se queja porque Fernando le pidió contratar modelos baratas.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia le cuenta a Marcia cómo vio a Paula María con Omar; Jazmín convence a Efrén para que la deje trabajar en Conceptos y Lola se molesta; Marcia le recuerda a Alicia el préstamo que le hizo.

programme.title: The Black Sleep
programme.desc: Basil Rathbone, Bela Lugosi, Lon Chaney, Jr. and John Carradine star in this terrifying horror classic about a brain surgeon's unorthodox experiments.

programme.title: The Manster
programme.desc: An American reporter in Japan becomes the unwitting subject of a mad scientist's twisted experiment in this terrifying tale of ambition gone berserk.

programme.title: Count Yorga, Vampire
programme.desc: Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they're outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!

programme.title: The Return Of Count Yorga
programme.desc: It's a love story with bite when a revived Count Yorga roams the city in search of new blood...until he finds a girl to share eternity with!

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

programme.title: Scream, Blacula, Scream!
programme.desc: Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel

programme.title: The Amityville Horror (1979)
programme.desc: James Brolin, Margot Kidder and Rod Steiger star in this horror classic as George and Kathy Lutz (Brolin, Kidder) buy their dream home only for it to becomes a hellish nightmare as satanic forces haunt them with sheer, unbridled evil!

programme.title: Amityville 3-D
programme.desc: The home of unspeakable evil is back! Tony Roberts, Tess Harper, Robert Joy, Candy Clark and Meg Ryan star in this third outing to Amityville in which a skeptical journalist sets out to debunk the Amityville house's reputation for unspeakable evil.

programme.title: The Horror Show
programme.desc: A maniacal murderer (Brion James) returns from the depths of hell to seek revenge on the cop who captured him in this supernatural horror-fest!

programme.title: Pumpkinhead
programme.desc: In this atmospheric horror classic directed by special effect legend Stan Winston, Ed Harley (Lance Henriksen) seeks the help of a witch to invoke the demon "Pumpkinhead" in order to exact revenge on the teenagers who inadvertently killed his son.

programme.title: Monkey Shines: An Experiment In Fear
programme.desc: In this classic spine-tingler, a paralyzed man (Jason Beghe) is cared for by Ella, an intelligent monkey. But when Ella seems to begin reading Allan's darker thoughts, he must stop the cunning maniacal creature...before she takes over his mind!

programme.title: The Beast Within
programme.desc: Seventeen years after a woman is attacked by a barely glimpsed creature in a Mississippi swamp, her teenage son's beastly nature surfaces and he begins a reign of terror in this exciting story of a human-into monster transformation.

programme.title: American Gothic
programme.desc: The family that slays together stays together when six young travelers find themselves at the mercy of the eccentric Ma, Pa and their "children."

programme.title: Donovan's Brain
programme.desc: Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its ownand is controlling him through telepathic messages!

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

programme.title: The Monster That Challenged The World
programme.desc: The beaches go from fun-filled swim-fests to horrifying slug-fests when gargantuan vampire snails threaten to suck the life out of all mankind!

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space

programme.desc: Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is neververy close.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his wordeven the Air Forceand soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But waitdid he even want to?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hootervilleand she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc stood him up at the alter on their big day.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.desc: After her involvement in a crime committed in Philadelphia, Regina, an old friend of Althea's runs to Sparta.

programme.desc: Harriet is determined to bring her sister's killer to justice and decides to try handling things on her own.

programme.desc: When an old friend apparently commits suicide, Virgil travels to Philadelphia and uncovers corruption.

programme.desc: Gillespie travels to Philadelphia to help Tibbs, who was mistakenly arrested for the murder of a policeman

programme.desc: A young prostitute and mother is found murdered at a truck stop. But prime suspect has an alibi.

programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs investigate an allegation that a popular school teacher has molested a student.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A drug dealer flees the scene after he runs over a young boy. Gillespie is determined to see him stand trial.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Lieutenant Bubba Skinner rekindles a romance with his high school sweetheart.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: While fishing on his day off, Bubba Skinner's dog unearths a dead baby.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Having served his time, Prosper Hoag is on parole and back home in Sparta. Will the folks in town forgive him?

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie's relationship with Harriet DeLong is tested when her ex-husband is caught committing a robbery.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs question the suspicious circumstances around the death of an elderly shop owner.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Virgil is working hard to reunite his family, when he discovers that his cousin may be involved in a murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: The owner of a local gym in Sparta tries to protect her delinquent brother, who is falsely accused of murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: It's Christmastime and an eager journalist from the local newspaper begs to interview the police force.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs investigate a fatal car crash and medical reports show the driver may have been poisoned.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Will time run out for a death row prisoner as the Sparta police attempt to save his life?

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When a local boy dies of an overdose, Gillespie wants a high schooler charged with murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sparta Police investigate a suspicious car crash and discover connections to a fraudulent development plan.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A blind woman witnesses the murder of her neighbor. But her life may be in danger too.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A student is the only witness to the rape of his teacher, but his father refuses to allow him to get involved.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Bubba Skinner goes to Los Angeles to take custody of a suspected arsonist and bring him back to Sparta.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: The ex-husband of Harriet DeLong has been charged with murder and is facing a death sentence.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A young witness is reluctant to come forward after a double murder at a local roadhouse.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: An old flame of Gillespie's reappears in Sparta with her daughter, the product of the affair that they had.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Bubba gets involved when his cousin and her husband are blackmailed by the birth father of their adopted baby.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A teacher in Sparta with her multiple romances attracts negative attention from the townsfolk.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: The fun and games come to a halt when the wealthy host of an annual high-stakes poker party is murdered.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Bubba finds himself in trouble when he is in involved in an accidental shooting while on the job.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Bubba Skinner returns to Los Angeles to tie up some unfinished business on an arson case.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Money and a secret love affair drive a businessman to stop at nothing to bring his partner down.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Wilson Sweet searches for the truth about the murder of his grandfather over forty years ago.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: For Bubba Skinner and his date, a picnic ends in gunshots and the discovery of a large marijuana operation.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: The daughter of a district attorney is kidnapped and Gillespie and Tibbs sidestep the FBI to bring her home.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Lonnie finds a connection between his high school crush and a recent armed robbery of a local supermarket.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When a greasy slumlord is found murdered, Gillespie will need the help of a savvy informant.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical...it is actually Justin himself.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip...to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn't trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they've all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to "Double Helix"

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: Rebelde

programme.title: Rebelde

programme.title: Rebelde

programme.desc: Roberta le ofrece a Lupita hablar con Lola para que ya no se sienta triste, pero Lola no acepta que Lupita no le haya dicho la verdad sobre su origen desde un principio. Pilar pelea con Sol por sus burlas. Lupita se reconcilia con Lola.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

programme.title: Cabin Fever
programme.desc: Bert (James DeBello), a college student vacationing with friends in the mountains, mistakenly shoots a local man (Arie Verveen) with a skin infection while hunting in the woods. programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Sucedió en México
programme.desc: Una mujer que planeaba suicidarse cambia de opinión y decide vivir e iniciar una nueva vida.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: El extensionista
programme.desc: Un ingeniero va a enseñar a los campesinos a mejorar sus cultivos y descubre la gran opresión del cacique del pueblo.

programme.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo
programme.desc: Un espíritu vengativo se apodera de una joven suicida en un centro de tratamientos. Sucesos misteriosos del pasado atormentan el presente.

programme.title: El último túnel
programme.desc: Un ingeniero que participa en la construcción de una monumental línea de ferrocarril se enamora de una hermosa tarahumara.

programme.title: Desaparecidos
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer viajan en el tiempo para comprobar la veracidad de una leyenda que afirma que un pueblo entero desapareció completamente.

programme.title: Las movidas del Mofles
programme.desc: Un mecánico borracho choca el auto de un diputado y termina en la cárcel, así que sus compañeros cooperan para sacarlo.

programme.title: Camino al infierno
programme.desc: Tres ex convictos continúan sus vidas en el crimen, ya que al salir de la cárcel violan y matan a un grupo de turistas.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: El Payo: un hombre contra el mundo
programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: Las sobrinas del Diablo
programme.desc: Un cacique asesina al propietario de unas tierras y a su mujer para adueñarse de ellas. El criminal no contaba con que las hijas habían escapado y tratarán de vengarse con la ayuda del Diablo, quien las cuidó desde pequeñas.
